title: ImpulseSV Cookies
description: A ResourcePack that turns the minecraft cookie into a impulse cookie!
body:
# ImpulseSV COOKIES

### **This is a texture pack that was requested by some comments in Grians most recent video!**

 You can view it [here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dhqjqcTeXRQ&t=91s)

 Impulse was trying to build a decorated cookie which was interpreted as Impulses face smashed into a pizza! 

![check it](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f15c35aaae992464465dcdc012b58c203f4daaa6_0.webp)

[West-Musician-2533 also did this](https://www.reddit.com/r/HermitCraft/comments/1pgrlms/impizza/)
